title: Verify Service Advisor cannot reverse a Part Sales invoice
preconds:
Log in to ShopView as a user assigned the Service Advisor role. (reversing a Part Sales invoice requires Part Sales: Delete per spec v33; this role has Part Sales = View/Create and Edit, NO Delete).
Note: the role may display as 'Junior Service Advisor' in the build (the spec calls it 'Service Advisor').
At least one Part Sales invoice exists under Part Sales.
steps:
1. Click Part Sales and open an existing invoice.
2. Look for a Reverse option; if present, click it.
expected: Reversing the Part Sales invoice is BLOCKED: the action is hidden/disabled or returns a permission error.
